records.source: I went shopping last night and picked up {1} {2} on sale for only {3}g.#$e# I couldn't pass up that great price.
records.translation: Namili ako kagabi at bumili ng {1} {2} na may diskuwento sa halagang {3}g lang.#$e# Hindi ko mapalampas ang napakagandang presyong iyon.

records.source: So I was at the store the other day and Pierre showed me {1} {2} you brought in.#$e#I bought it.$h
records.translation: Nasa tindahan ako noong isang araw at ipinakita sa akin ni Pierre ang {1} {2} na dinala mo.#$e#Binili ko iyon.$h

records.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. #$b#He said that he grew the thing in his own backyard. I didn't know Pierre was such a talented farmer!$h#$b#Looks like you might have some competition, huh?
records.translation: Binili ko ang pinakamasarap na {2} sa tindahan ni Pierre noong isang araw. #$b#Sinabi niyang siya mismo ang nagtanim niyon sa bakuran niya. Hindi ko alam na napakahusay palang magsasaka ni Pierre!$h#$b#Mukhang may kakumpitensiya ka, ha?

records.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. #$b#He said he cooked the thing himself using local ingredients. I didn't know Pierre was such {3} {4} chef!
records.translation: Binili ko ang pinakamasarap na {2} sa tindahan ni Pierre noong isang araw. #$b#Sinabi niyang siya mismo ang nagluto niyon gamit ang mga lokal na sangkap. Hindi ko alam na isa palang {3} {4} kusinero si Pierre!

records.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. He said he found it himself while exploring the mountains. I didn't know Pierre was such a talented forager!
records.translation: Binili ko ang pinakamasarap na {2} sa tindahan ni Pierre noong isang araw. Sinabi niyang siya mismo ang nakahanap niyon habang naglilibot sa mga bundok. Hindi ko alam na napakahusay pala ni Pierre sa pangangalap!

records.source: Hey, so I picked up {2} at the store last night. My mom wanted something good for dinner.
records.translation: Hoy, bumili ako ng {2} sa tindahan kagabi. Gusto ni Nanay ng masarap para sa hapunan.

records.source: Hey. We had one of those {2}s you sold at the shop for dinner last night... I guess it was starting to go bad and my Dad couldn't bear to throw it out.$h#$b#Unfortunately it tasted like {3}.$s
records.translation: Hoy. Kinain namin sa hapunan kagabi ang isa sa mga {2} na ibinenta mo sa tindahan... Mukhang nagsisimula na iyong masira at hindi maatim ni Tatay na itapon iyon.$h#$b#Sa kasamaang-palad, lasang {3} iyon.$s

records.source: Hey. We had one of those {2}s you sold at the shop for dinner last night... I guess it was starting to go bad and my Dad couldn't bear to throw it out.$h#$b#It was still pretty good, though.
records.translation: Hoy. Kinain namin sa hapunan kagabi ang isa sa mga {2} na ibinenta mo sa tindahan... Mukhang nagsisimula na iyong masira at hindi maatim ni Tatay na itapon iyon.$h#$b#Pero medyo masarap pa rin.

records.source: Oh, @... This is embarrassing. I threw one of your {2}s you sold us into my compost bin.$s#$b#Now the whole thing smells horrendous. Where did you find that thing again?
records.translation: O, @... Nakakahiya ito. Itinapon ko sa sisidlan ng kompost ang isa sa mga {2} mo na ibinenta mo sa amin.$s#$b#Napakabaho na ngayon ng buong laman. Saan mo nga ulit nahanap ang bagay na iyon?

records.source: Oh, @... This is embarrassing. I threw one of your {2}s you sold us into my compost bin.$s#$b#But on the bright side, the worms are really loving it! They've never looked happier!
records.translation: O, @... Nakakahiya ito. Itinapon ko sa sisidlan ng kompost ang isa sa mga {2} mo na ibinenta mo sa amin.$s#$b#Pero sa kabutihang-palad, gustong-gusto iyon ng mga uod! Hindi pa sila kailanman mukhang mas masaya!

records.source: Hey, remember that {2} you sold me the other day? I ended up serving it to the family for a special dinner.#$b#I can't say it was a hit... $s#$b#... well,... back to business, huh?
records.translation: Hoy, naaalala mo ang {2} na ibinenta mo sa akin noong isang araw? Inihain ko iyon sa pamilya para sa espesyal na hapunan.#$b#Hindi ko masasabing nagustuhan iyon... $s#$b#... buweno,... balik sa negosyo, ha?

records.source: Hey, remember that {2} you sold me the other day? I ended up serving it to the family for a special dinner.#$b#My wife loved it! ...And Abby even started going to town on it after I smothered the thing in hoisin sauce. $h#$b#... well,... back to business, huh?
records.translation: Hoy, naaalala mo ang {2} na ibinenta mo sa akin noong isang araw? Inihain ko iyon sa pamilya para sa espesyal na hapunan.#$b#Nagustuhan iyon ng asawa ko! ...At nasarapan pa si Abby matapos kong balutin ang bagay na iyon ng sarsang hoisin. $h#$b#... buweno,... balik sa negosyo, ha?

records.source: Emily tried to serve me {1} {2} for dinner last night... I threw it away when she wasn't looking.#$e#I don't like health food...$s
records.translation: Sinubukan akong ihainan ni Emily ng {1} {2} para sa hapunan kagabi... Itinapon ko iyon nang hindi siya nakatingin.#$e#Ayaw ko ng masustansiyang pagkain...$s

records.source: I saw that Pierre had fresh {2} in the shop the other day! Marvelous. It smelled just perfect... and firm, too!
records.translation: Nakita kong may sariwang {2} sa tindahan ni Pierre noong isang araw! Kahanga-hanga. Tamang-tama ang amoy nito... at matigas din!

records.source: Hey, so I picked up {1} {2} at the store last night. Grandma made her special casserole...
records.translation: Hoy, bumili ako ng {1} {2} sa tindahan kagabi. Ginawa ni Lola ang espesyal niyang kaserol...

records.source: The other day I bought {1} {2} at Pierre's. It was perfect on a bed of greens and a dash of my 'special' vinaigrette.
records.translation: Noong isang araw ay bumili ako ng {1} {2} kay Pierre. Perpekto iyon sa ibabaw ng mga berdeng gulay at kaunting 'espesyal' kong vinaigrette.

records.source: Hey, {0}.#$b# So I stopped by Willy's the other day and bought {1} {2}. I've never seen one so fresh! #$b#So I cooked it up for dinner last night, and it filled the house with a {3} smell.. It was a hit!$h#$b#He told me you caught it yourself... I'm impressed!#$e# Anyways...
records.translation: Hoy, {0}.#$b# Dumaan ako kay Willy noong isang araw at bumili ng {1} {2}. Hindi pa ako nakakita ng ganoon kasariwa! #$b#Kaya niluto ko iyon para sa hapunan kagabi, at pinuno nito ang bahay ng {3} na amoy.. Nagustuhan ng lahat!$h#$b#Sinabi niyang ikaw mismo ang humuli niyon... Hanga ako!#$e# Siyanga pala...

records.source: Hey, {0}.#$b# So I stopped by Willy's the other day and bought {1} {2}. He said you caught it yourself! #$b#I cooked it up for dinner last night... and, uh... It filled the house with a {3} odor. I don't even want to know where you found that thing...$s#$e#Anyways...
records.translation: Hoy, {0}.#$b# Dumaan ako kay Willy noong isang araw at bumili ng {1} {2}. Sinabi niyang ikaw mismo ang humuli niyon! #$b#Niluto ko iyon para sa hapunan kagabi... at, uh... Pinuno nito ang bahay ng {3} na amoy. Ayaw ko nang malaman kung saan mo nahanap ang bagay na iyon...$s#$e#Siyanga pala...

records.source: Hi... did you sell {1} {2} to the fish shop the other day? I think I bought it...#$e#It was pretty high-quality stuff. I'm impressed.
records.translation: Kumusta... nagbenta ka ba ng {1} {2} sa tindahan ng isda noong isang araw? Sa tingin ko ay binili ko iyon...#$e#Napakataas ng kalidad niyon. Hanga ako.

records.source: Hi... did you sell {1} {2} to the fish shop the other day? I think I bought it...#$e#It was pretty high-quality stuff. Very firm meat.
records.translation: Kumusta... nagbenta ka ba ng {1} {2} sa tindahan ng isda noong isang araw? Sa tingin ko ay binili ko iyon...#$e#Napakataas ng kalidad niyon. Siksik ang laman.

records.source: Hi... did you sell {1} {2} to the general store the other day? I think I bought it...#$e#It smelled kind of fishy, but it was alright.
records.translation: Kumusta... nagbenta ka ba ng {1} {2} sa tindahang panlahat noong isang araw? Sa tingin ko ay binili ko iyon...#$e#Medyo malansa ang amoy, pero ayos naman.

records.source: I went shopping last night and picked up {1} {2} on a 'chum-bucket' sale for only {3}g.#$e# It was {4}! No wonder Willy was practically giving that {5} away...
records.translation: Namili ako kagabi at bumili ng {1} {2} sa diskuwentong 'timba ng pain' sa halagang {3}g lang.#$e# {4} iyon! Kaya pala halos ipinamimigay na ni Willy ang {5} na iyon...

records.source: I went shopping last night and picked up {1} {2} on sale for only {3}g.#$e# It was actually pretty {4}.
records.translation: Namili ako kagabi at bumili ng {1} {2} na may diskuwento sa halagang {3}g lang.#$e# Talagang medyo {4} iyon.

records.source: I went shopping last night and picked up {1} {2} on sale for only {3}g.#$e# I couldn't pass up that great price.
records.translation: Namili ako kagabi at bumili ng {1} {2} na may diskuwento sa halagang {3}g lang.#$e# Hindi ko mapalampas ang napakagandang presyong iyon.

records.source: So I was at Willy's other day and he showed me {1} {2} you brought in.#$e#I cooked it up for dinner with some lemon and a side of rice pilaf. Pretty good!$h
records.translation: Nasa tindahan ako ni Willy noong isang araw at ipinakita niya sa akin ang {1} {2} na dinala mo.#$e#Niluto ko iyon para sa hapunan kasama ang kaunting limon at kanin na pilaf. Medyo masarap!$h

records.source: Ahoy... you know that {2} you sold me the other day? Well, I sizzled it up in me cabin last night...#$b#T'was the mealiest fish I've ever set me gums on...$s
records.translation: Ahoy... alam mo ang {2} na ibinenta mo sa akin noong isang araw? Buweno, pinirito ko iyon sa kubo ko kagabi...#$b#Iyon ang pinakamalambot at pinakawalang-lasang isdang nakain ko...$s

records.source: Ahoy! Remember that {2} you brought in the other day? Well, I sizzled it up in me cabin last night...#$b#T'was the finest fish I've had since I was a wee lad!$h
records.translation: Ahoy! Naaalala mo ang {2} na dinala mo noong isang araw? Buweno, pinirito ko iyon sa kubo ko kagabi...#$b#Iyon ang pinakamasarap na isdang nakain ko mula noong bata pa ako!$h

records.source: Eww... What are you doing?$s
records.translation: Eww... Ano ang ginagawa mo?$s

records.source: Um... Why are you digging in the trash?$s
records.translation: Um... Bakit mo hinahalungkat ang basura?$s

records.source: Hey, Stop that! ...Yuck!$s
records.translation: Hoy, tigilan mo iyan! ...Kadiri!$s

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your {1} upgrade the day after tomorrow. I always take festivals off.$h
records.translation: Sige, sisimulan kong gawin ang pagpapahusay sa {1} mo sa makalawa. Lagi akong nagpapahinga kapag may pista.$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your {1} upgrade first thing tomorrow morning!$h
records.translation: Sige, sisimulan kong gawin ang pagpapahusay sa {1} mo bukas na bukas sa umaga!$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your new {0} the day after tomorrow. I always take festivals off.$h
records.translation: Sige, sisimulan kong gawin ang bago mong {0} sa makalawa. Lagi akong nagpapahinga kapag may pista.$h

records.source: Okay, I'll start working on your new {0} first thing tomorrow morning!$h
records.translation: Sige, sisimulan kong gawin ang bago mong {0} bukas na bukas sa umaga!$h

records.source: This {0} is pre-fabricated, so there's no construction time! Convenient, isn't it?$h
records.translation: Paunang binuo ang {0} na ito, kaya wala nang oras ng pagtatayo! Maginhawa, hindi ba?$h

records.source: Excellent! We'll get our workers on it tonight. It should be ready for you by tomorrow.
records.translation: Mahusay! Ipagagawa namin iyon sa mga manggagawa namin ngayong gabi. Dapat ay handa na iyon bukas.

records.source: Ah, our favorite customer... I have exciting news for you! Joja headquarters has approved the construction of a new Joja 'entertainment opportunity' to replace the nearby Joja Warehouse. We just need an investor willing to support our vision! So, naturally, I turn to you... our most devoted and generous Joja member.#$b#$q -1 -1#We could make this happen for a small investment of... *cough*... 500,000g...$h#$r -1 -1 Yes#Yes#$r -1 -1 No#No
records.translation: Ah, ang paborito naming mamimili... May kapana-panabik akong balita para sa iyo! Inaprubahan ng punong tanggapan ng Joja ang pagtatayo ng bagong 'pagkakataong panlibangan' ng Joja na papalit sa kalapit na Bodega ng Joja. Kailangan lang namin ng mamumuhunang handang sumuporta sa aming pananaw! Kaya siyempre, sa iyo ako lumalapit... ang pinakamatapat at mapagbigay naming Miyembro ng Joja.#$b#$q -1 -1#Maisasakatuparan natin ito sa maliit na puhunan na... *ubo*... 500,000g...$h#$r -1 -1 Yes#Oo#$r -1 -1 No#Hindi

records.source: Half a mil...!$2#$b#*Ahem*... I mean... Excellent! Our Joja Construction Team will begin work on the new building tonight! Thank you for supporting our work.
records.translation: Kalahating milyon...!$2#$b#*Ahem*... Ang ibig kong sabihin... Mahusay! Sisimulan ng Pangkat sa Pagtatayo ng Joja ang pagtatayo ng bagong gusali ngayong gabi! Salamat sa pagsuporta sa gawain namin.

records.source: Ah! My favorite customer... Unfortunately I have no more community development projects available at the moment.
records.translation: Ah! Ang paborito kong mamimili... Sa kasamaang-palad, wala akong maiaalok na iba pang proyekto sa pagpapaunlad ng komunidad sa ngayon.

records.source: Are you okay? I found you washed up on the shore, lad.$s^Are you okay? I found you washed up on the shore, miss.$s#$b#You really had me worried... I thought you were a goner! Be a little more careful out there...$s#$b#The island can be a dangerous place.
records.translation: Ayos ka lang ba? Natagpuan kitang inanod sa pampang, iho.$s^Ayos ka lang ba? Natagpuan kitang inanod sa pampang, binibini.$s#$b#Talagang pinag-alala mo ako... Akala ko ay patay ka na! Mag-ingat ka pa nang kaunti roon...$s#$b#Maaaring mapanganib ang isla.

records.source: It seems like you're going to live.$u#$b#My bird-friends spotted you and told me you were in danger, so I dragged you all the way down here.$s#$b#Please be safe out there. I don't want to be sad anymore...$s
records.translation: Mukhang mabubuhay ka.$u#$b#Nakita ka ng mga kaibigan kong ibon at sinabi nilang nasa panganib ka, kaya kinaladkad kita hanggang dito.$s#$b#Mag-ingat ka roon. Ayaw ko nang malungkot...$s

records.source: I never thought I'd see a new face on this island, dear. But I'm glad you're here!
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang makakakita ako ng bagong mukha sa islang ito, mahal. Pero natutuwa akong narito ka!

records.source: It's rumored that long ago, a great civilization of dwarves lived on this very island.#$e#Have you been inside the volcano? It's filled with the ruins of their strange machines...
records.translation: May sabi-sabing matagal na ang nakalipas, isang dakilang kabihasnan ng mga duwende ang namuhay sa mismong islang ito.#$e#Nakapunta ka na ba sa loob ng bulkan? Punô iyon ng mga guho ng kanilang kakaibang mga makina...

records.source: If you're ever feeling queasy in the stomach, a bite of ginger does wonders, dear...
records.translation: Kung sumasama ang tiyan mo, nakagagawa ng himala ang isang kagat ng luya, mahal...

records.source: Have you been to the secret shrine in the jungle? The flowers there smell lovely... It's one of my favorite spots on the island.$h
records.translation: Nakapunta ka na ba sa lihim na dambana sa gubat? Napakabango ng mga bulaklak doon... Isa iyon sa mga paborito kong lugar sa isla.$h

records.source: Every morning for breakfast, I have a bowl of poi and a glass of freshly squeezed mango juice. It keeps me young!
records.translation: Tuwing umaga sa almusal, kumakain ako ng isang mangkok ng poi at umiinom ng isang baso ng bagong pigang katas ng mangga. Pinananatili akong bata niyon!

records.source: I walk the beach every day to see if anything new has washed ashore. There's a lot floating around out there!
records.translation: Naglalakad ako sa dalampasigan araw-araw upang tingnan kung may bagong inanod sa pampang. Napakaraming palutang-lutang doon!

records.source: My hut may be small, but it's more than enough for what I need. And best of all, I built it myself.
records.translation: Maaaring maliit ang kubo ko, pero higit pa sa sapat iyon para sa mga kailangan ko. At higit sa lahat, ako mismo ang nagtayo niyon.
